controls.regle: Routine operational tasks (start/stop, deployment, purge, rotation, scheduled jobs) are described in up-to-date runbooks, executable by a person unfamiliar with the application code.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of runbooks covering the declared routine operational tasks and have a procedure executed by a person outside the development team.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented runbooks for each routine operation + execution report by a third-party person.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete runbooks successfully executed by a third-party person ; partial = partial runbooks or requiring assistance from the development team ; non-compliant = routine operations not documented
actions_audit: List the routine operational tasks and verify the existence of a runbook for each.
Have a representative procedure executed by a person outside the development team.
If gap: draft the missing runbooks and correct the procedures that required assistance.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des opérations informatiques

controls.regle: A formalized incident procedure covers detection, escalation (including the breakage of an integration pipeline or the breach of an error budget threshold) and on-call mobilization, with a bounded and measured response time.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a documented incident and on-call procedure, covering the detection-escalation-mobilization chain, and measure the response time on a real or simulated incident.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented incident and on-call procedure + response time measurement from an exercise or a real incident.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = documented procedure, operational on-call, response time measured and met ; partial = documented procedure without time measurement ; non-compliant = absence of a formalized incident or on-call procedure
actions_audit: Verify the existence of the incident procedure and the on-call chain (rotation, contacts, escalation).
Measure the response time on a simulated exercise or the latest real incident.
If gap: formalize the missing procedure and schedule a trigger exercise.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des incidents

controls.regle: Each application has a justified criticality classification (e.g. S1 to S4) and a declared service level agreement (SLA) consistent with this criticality.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a justified criticality classification and a declared SLA consistent with this classification (service hours, target availability, response times).
controls.preuve_attendue: Justified criticality classification sheet + declared SLA document.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = justified classification and consistent SLA formally declared ; partial = declared classification without justification or incomplete SLA ; non-compliant = no classification or SLA declared
actions_audit: Verify the declared criticality classification and its justification with regard to business impact.
Verify the consistency of the declared SLA with the chosen classification.
If gap: establish or correct the classification and align the corresponding SLA.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des niveaux de service

controls.regle: Incidents are managed using a dedicated tool (tracking, history, actions) and every significant incident is subject to a blameless post-mortem, including a documented rollback exercise where relevant.
controls.verification: Verify the use of an incident management tool and the existence of documented post-mortems for significant incidents over the last 12 months, including the measurement of restoration time.
controls.preuve_attendue: Extract from the incident management tool + sample of documented post-mortems with measured restoration time.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = tool in place, systematic post-mortems with measured restoration time ; partial = tool in place, partial or informal post-mortems ; non-compliant = incidents not tracked or no post-mortem performed
actions_audit: Verify the effective use of the incident management tool over the last 12 months.
Sample the post-mortems performed and verify the measurement of restoration time and the absence of individual blame.
If gap: instrument the missing tracking and systematize the post-mortem for every significant incident.

controls.regle: Each production asset has a documented responsibility matrix (RACI), with at least two people actually capable of intervening in operations (bus factor ≥ 2), and the matrix is reviewed at least once a year.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a RACI matrix per production asset, the identification of at least two real operators per critical asset, and the date of the matrix's last review.
controls.preuve_attendue: Timestamped export of the RACI matrix + report of the last review (< 12 months).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete matrix, bus factor ≥ 2 verified and reviewed < 12 months ago ; partial = complete matrix but bus factor = 1 on some assets or overdue review ; non-compliant = at least one asset without an identified owner
actions_audit: Extract the RACI matrix and verify that no production asset is without an identified Accountable.
Verify, by sampling, that each critical asset has at least two genuinely operational responders.
If gap: complete the matrix and organize knowledge transfer to a second responder.
standards: COBIT 2019 (composant Structures organisationnelles — RACI par pratique)

controls.regle: A tolerated data loss objective (RPO) and restoration time objective (RTO) is declared for each critical asset, and the restoration capability is periodically tested with proof of compliance.
controls.verification: Verify the RPO/RTO declaration per critical asset and the record of the last real restoration exercise, with measurement of the duration and integrity of the restored data.
controls.preuve_attendue: RPO/RTO declared per asset + report of the last restoration exercise (duration, observed integrity).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = RPO/RTO declared and restoration successfully tested within the last 12 months ; partial = objectives declared without a recent test ; non-compliant = no declared objectives or last test failed and not corrected
actions_audit: Verify the RPO/RTO declaration for each critical asset and its consistency with business tolerance.
Verify the report of the last real restoration exercise (duration achieved, observed integrity).
If gap: declare the missing objectives and schedule a restoration exercise.

controls.regle: A business continuity plan covers major disaster scenarios (site loss, prolonged unavailability of a critical supplier) with defined roles, a crisis communication procedure and periodic testing.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a continuity plan covering the applicable major disaster scenarios, the designation of crisis roles, and the date of the last test or exercise.
controls.preuve_attendue: Documented continuity plan + report of the last continuity test or exercise.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = documented plan covering the applicable scenarios and tested within the last 12 months ; partial = documented plan without a recent test ; non-compliant = no formalized continuity plan
actions_audit: Verify the continuity plan's coverage with regard to the disaster scenarios applicable to the application.
Verify the designation of crisis roles and the existence of a communication procedure.
If gap: complete the plan and schedule a test exercise.
standards: ISO/IEC 27002:2022 — 5.29 (sécurité de l'information pendant une perturbation)

controls.regle: Operational access to production (deployment, on-call intervention, emergency access) is named, traced, and the emergency access mode ("break-glass") is documented and logged when used.
controls.verification: Verify that production operational access is named, the existence of a documented emergency access procedure, and the logging of its actual use.
controls.preuve_attendue: Inventory of production operational access + emergency access procedure + extract from the usage log of this procedure.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = named access, emergency procedure documented and logged ; partial = named access without a formalized emergency procedure ; non-compliant = shared or untraced access
actions_audit: Inventory the accounts with production operational access and verify that they are named.
Verify the existence of the emergency access procedure and, if it has been used, the trace left behind.
If gap: assign names to shared access and formalize the missing emergency procedure.
standards: ITIL 4 — pratique de gestion des accès

controls.regle: The transfer of the application to the operations team (RUN) is formalized through a complete application handover file, the registration of the service in the inventory repository, and a traced handover between the owner and the RUN team.
controls.verification: Verify the existence of a complete application handover file, the actual registration of the service in the inventory repository, and the record of a formal handover between the owner and the RUN team.
controls.preuve_attendue: Application handover file + extract from the inventory repository + dated and signed handover report.
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = complete file, service referenced, handover traced and signed ; partial = incomplete file or service not referenced ; non-compliant = no handover file or formalized handover
actions_audit: Verify the completeness of the application handover file against the expected reference framework.
Verify the registration of the service in the inventory repository and its freshness.
If gap: complete the missing file and schedule the formal handover with the RUN team.

controls.regle: A security incident response procedure is defined, tested and tooled: detection, qualification, containment, evidence preservation, lessons learned.
controls.verification: Verify the response procedure (roles, channels, steps), the record of an exercise or a handled incident, and the evidence preservation capability (protected logs, freeze).
controls.grille_verdict: compliant = procedure tested with preservable evidence ; partial = procedure not tested ; non-compliant = no response procedure
actions_audit: Collect the procedure and the last exercise; attach them.
Verify the link with tamper-proof logging (CTL-D03-08) for the evidence.
If gap: formalize the procedure, schedule an exercise, tool the preservation.
